data.title: After MicroStrategy, another crypto company sells Bitcoin
data.description: The ongoing crypto winter has forced Michael Saylor's Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR), formerly MicroStrategy, to sell Bitcoin (BTC) twice this year. 32 Bitcoin for around $2.5 million during May 26-313,588 BTC for $216 million during June 29-July 5 The company has sold Bitcoin for the first time after ...
